analysis.insight_summary: The user is experiencing an issue where ON TIME and OFF TIME values in the web interface display as '16#FF,' which reflects an unexpected value due to using an older version of [product_name]. Newer versions handle timer values differently and solve this problem, but the user is currently unable to upgrade the software due to download restrictions, leaving the issue unresolved.
analysis.user_expectations: The user expects correct timer value display within the web interface, a solution for the '16#FF' issue, and an easy process to upgrade to the latest compatible software version.
